name: toolbox
description: A side bar listing every mod and skill, one boxed row each: click a switch (green on, red off) to flip it, pick a skin from a dropdown, or click any other row to put its command in the prompt box.

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the side bar at session start where the screen can dock it beside the chat (fullscreen terminal, desktop app). Never reopens it after you close it; /toolbox and typing toolbox toggle it.
